classification.difficultyReason: The source labels this question Development. Parts combine exterior angles with supplementary angles, equal angles in isosceles triangles and vertically opposite angles; written reasoning is not required.

content.prompt: Find the value of each pronumeral, you do not need to show reasoning.

spec.description: Oblique triangle with its left-to-upper side extended down-left; h is the exterior angle at the left vertex.
spec.mathematics: The opposite interior angles are 86 degrees and 18 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens and the unknown label appear in the question diagram.

spec.description: Triangle with 84 degrees at the upper-left vertex, y at the lower-left vertex, and its upper edge extended beyond the right vertex.
spec.mathematics: The exterior angle at the right vertex is 100 degrees.

spec.description: Triangle with left side extended upwards; d is the interior upper-left angle and e the adjacent exterior angle.
spec.mathematics: The lower-left and right interior angles are 70 degrees and 25 degrees.

answer.worked:
Exterior angle theorem gives $e$; adjacent angles on a straight line give $d$.
$$\begin{align*}e&=70^{\circ}+25^{\circ}\\e&=95^{\circ}\\d&=180^{\circ}-95^{\circ}\\d&=85^{\circ}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Thin triangle pointing right, with a near-vertical left edge extended below its lower vertex.
spec.mathematics: The left interior angles are a and b; the right angle is 14 degrees and the lower-left exterior angle is 130 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source givens and unknown labels appear.

answer.worked:
Adjacent angles on a straight line give $a$; the exterior angle theorem gives $b$.
$$\begin{align*}a&=180^{\circ}-130^{\circ}\\a&=50^{\circ}\\b+14^{\circ}&=130^{\circ}\\b&=116^{\circ}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Right triangle with vertical left side and horizontal upper side; the rising diagonal extends past the upper-right vertex.
spec.mathematics: A square marks the upper-left right angle. The lower-left interior angle is 45 degrees, and m is the upper-right exterior angle.
spec.answerVisibility: The exterior angle is labelled m, with no answer.

spec.description: Triangle on a horizontal base, with its left sloping side extended above the upper vertex.
spec.mathematics: The base angles are 83 degrees and 31 degrees; x is the upper interior angle and y its adjacent exterior angle.
spec.answerVisibility: The question contains x and y labels only.

answer.worked:
Exterior angle theorem gives $y$; adjacent angles on a straight line give $x$.
$$\begin{align*}y&=83^{\circ}+31^{\circ}\\y&=114^{\circ}\\x&=180^{\circ}-114^{\circ}\\x&=66^{\circ}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Triangle with vertical left edge extended below the lower-left vertex and an unknown angle at the right vertex.
spec.mathematics: The upper-left interior angle is 59 degrees, the lower-left exterior angle is 126 degrees, and the right interior angle is e.
spec.answerVisibility: No answer appears in the diagram.

spec.description: Narrow triangle pointing upper-right. The left-to-apex side extends down-left; the base extends to the right. An arrow connects the 11-degree annotation to the narrow apex angle.
spec.mathematics: The left base exterior angle is 162 degrees; the apex interior angle is 11 degrees; h is the right base exterior angle.
spec.answerVisibility: The annotation 11 degrees is a permanent given; the unknown h remains unsolved.

answer.worked:
The left interior angle is supplementary to $162^{\circ}$. Then use the exterior angle theorem.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Left interior angle}&=180^{\circ}-162^{\circ}\\&=18^{\circ}\\h&=18^{\circ}+11^{\circ}\\h&=29^{\circ}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Inverted triangle with a horizontal upper side and both sloping sides extended upwards.
spec.mathematics: The exterior angles above the upper side are 130 degrees on the left and 140 degrees on the right; m is the lower interior angle.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the two givens and m appear.

answer.worked:
Use supplementary angles at the upper vertices, then the triangle angle sum.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Left interior angle}&=180^{\circ}-130^{\circ}=50^{\circ}\\\text{Right interior angle}&=180^{\circ}-140^{\circ}=40^{\circ}\\m&=180^{\circ}-50^{\circ}-40^{\circ}\\m&=90^{\circ}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Triangle on a horizontal base extended right, with matching double ticks on the base and right sloping side.
spec.mathematics: The left base angle is x. The right base exterior angle is 140 degrees. Equal marked sides imply the left base and apex angles are equal.
spec.answerVisibility: The equal-side marks are permanent givens; no angle answer is drawn.

answer.worked:
Angles opposite the equal sides are equal, so the apex angle is also $x$. By the exterior angle theorem:
$$\begin{align*}x+x&=140^{\circ}\\2x&=140^{\circ}\\x&=70^{\circ}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Triangle with a left vertex and two right vertices; matching single ticks mark the upper side and the left-to-lower-right side. The right edge extends upwards and the left-to-lower-right edge extends down-right.
spec.mathematics: The upper-right exterior angle is 130 degrees and the lower-right exterior angle is p. The two right interior angles are equal.

answer.worked:
The upper-right interior angle is supplementary to $130^{\circ}$. The two right interior angles are equal because they are opposite the equal sides.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Upper-right interior angle}&=180^{\circ}-130^{\circ}\\&=50^{\circ}\\\text{Lower-right interior angle}&=50^{\circ}\\p&=180^{\circ}-50^{\circ}\\p&=130^{\circ}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Isosceles triangle with matching double ticks on the sloping sides. Both sides extend through the apex to form an X, with w above the intersection.
spec.mathematics: The left base angle is 46 degrees. The upper angle w is vertically opposite the interior apex angle.
spec.answerVisibility: The right base and apex angles remain unlabelled; w is unsolved.

answer.worked:
The base angles are equal because the sloping sides are equal. Use the triangle angle sum, then vertically opposite angles.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Right base angle}&=46^{\circ}\\\text{Interior apex angle}&=180^{\circ}-46^{\circ}-46^{\circ}\\&=88^{\circ}\\w&=88^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
